other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Ceramic manufacturing described with continuous wet grinding rotary mills for slip preparation
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: The raw materials are mixed and wet ground in continuous rotary mills, until a liquid called slip is obtained.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Continuous roller kiln firing of ceramic tiles
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the humidity level reaches values suitable for 
firing in roller kilns at a temperature that reaches a maximum between 1180 and 1240 °C.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Tunnel kilns (continuous kilns) as most common brick firing kilns
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: The most common type is a tunnel kiln, followed by periodic kilns.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cogeneration / CHP used for self-production of electricity and heat in ceramic sites
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
less than 30% of electricity is self-produced 
through cogeneration, while the remaining is acquired [1].

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Diffusion of combined heat and power plants across the ceramic sector as main efficiency measure
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the strategy 
implemented by the sector in the last years mainly concerned the reduction of primary energy consumption  
by applying cogeneration/combined heat and power plants.

one_line: The paper empirically analyzes energy audits of the Italian ceramic tile and brick manufacturing industry to derive energy performance indicators; ceramics (with continuous rotary mills, roller/tunnel kilns and CHP) is not among the eight registered Corpus-B sectors.
